title: Participant fraud in online UX research: spot and stop it
summary: How to recognise, prevent and respond to participant fraud in online qualitative UX research, including AI-generated, bot and deepfake participants.
body_markdown:
Maria is an experienced UX researcher with a PhD in Cognitive Psychology and over a decade of experience across academia and industry. She has built and scaled UX research practices in fast-paced SaaS environments, and recently founded[Decaf Before Death](https://www.decafbeforedeath.co.uk/) , a specialty decaf coffee business. She writes the[UX Psychology newsletter](https://uxpsychology.substack.com/) and lives in Sheffield, UK, with her partner and two cats.
